en.title: Taylor Sheridan Thriller and More: Your Top Netflix Picks This Week
en.summary: Forget the box office buzz; the real action is on your streaming devices. This week, Netflix is serving up a potent mix of neo-western grit and animated fun.
en.body:
While the big screen saw a magical reunion dominate the box office, the streaming universe is offering a different kind of compelling drama. For those craving that signature blend of rugged landscapes and high stakes, **Taylor Sheridan**'s intense neo-western thriller, **Those Who Wish Me Dead**, is making serious waves on Netflix. This Angelina Jolie-led film, which sees a young boy on the run from assassins after witnessing a murder, has climbed into Netflix's top 10 most-streamed movies in the U.S., proving that Sheridan's particular brand of storytelling continues to captivate audiences.

Released in 2021, **Those Who Wish Me Dead** might feel like a throwback to the director's earlier works like **Hell or High Water** and **Wind River**. It’s a lean, mean, 100-minute machine that delivers on suspense and visceral action. The film showcases Jolie as a smokejumper battling a wildfire and her own demons while trying to protect the boy, a performance that highlights her ability to convey strength and vulnerability. It’s a testament to Sheridan’s skill that even when not directly helming a project, his influence is felt, guiding narratives that feel both classic and contemporary.

## What Fans Are Watching Now

Beyond the **Sheridan**-esque thrills, Netflix is also giving subscribers a chance to dive into other engaging titles. For a dose of gritty action, **Contraband**, starring **Mark Wahlberg**, offers a high-octane crime story about a smuggler trying to get out of the game. Its inclusion suggests a continued appetite for mid-budget genre films that provide straightforward, compelling entertainment. And for a complete change of pace, the animated classic **Shark Tale** is also making a splash. This DreamWorks film, featuring a star-studded voice cast, brings a vibrant, fish-out-of-water story to the platform, rounding out a diverse week of streaming options that cater to a wide range of tastes.

## What's Next

With **Those Who Wish Me Dead** and **Contraband** currently drawing significant attention, it's clear that audiences are eager for well-crafted genre films. While specific new additions to Netflix's trending list are always shifting, the success of these titles suggests we might see more films in a similar vein. Keep an eye on directorial talents who excel at building suspense and crafting compelling characters, as they are likely to be the next big hits on the platform.

content_raw: For the first time since its late-July debut, Spider-Man: Brand New Day lost its place at the top of the box office charts this past weekend. The Owens sisters, Sally and Gillian, were back to welcome the fall as Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman reprised their roles from 1998's Practical Magic . Practical Magic 2 , although it has faced a mixed reception from critics , managed to outperform Brand New Day and take the #1 spot at the box office with a $46 million global haul. But aside from the newest legacy sequel in theaters, what else should you be watching? To help you decide, here's a list of three movies you should stream on Netflix this week .
